content: I have a few PRs that have been around for some time and which haven't been reviewed (that's fine, although I believe they're important :-), like #43338 (preliminary to get the bundle of differential forms) or #42983 (IsNormable space, useful to construct Riemannian metrics). What surprises me more is that they haven't got any assigned reviewer, so I wanted to check that the automatic assignment bot is working fine (maybe everyone is already overwhelmed just like I am :-)
I have some PRs that have not been assigned after over a month and the system wanted to give me assignments though I am at capacity, so I would assume that there are no free reviewers
I think "overwhelmed" is definitely part of the story. I have #43338 on my list for several weeks now, and just need to get out of a pile of other urgent things first :-(
Same for the other PR, by the way.
